company_name: Sky Chip Interconnection Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in advanced packaging and testing solutions for semiconductor devices.
summary: Sky Chip Interconnection Technology Co., Ltd. is focused on providing advanced packaging and system integration solutions for semiconductor devices. Their offerings include wafer-level packaging (WLP), system-in-package (SiP), and board-level fan-out packaging (FOPLP), along with integrated circuit testing services.
